1.why: The few visible strings use a clean, legible sans-serif, but with only single-line headings and a status message the spacing looks standard rather than demonstrably generous.

2.why: All on-screen text ('Local Bank', 'Loading secure setup...', 'Logs') is short sentence-case with no italics, no all-caps, and no dense paragraphs.

3.why: The single-column layout with ample margins and simple boxed sections reads cleanly at a mobile screen width.

4.why: No instructional text is ever provided, only a 'Loading secure setup...' status, so there are no short plain instructions guiding the user.

5.why: No example of what expected input should look like (such as a sample code format) is shown anywhere on the screen.

6.why: The entire screen contains only two short strings, so the user is never required to read a long block of text.

7.why: No codes or secrets are ever displayed and no copy-to-clipboard control exists on the screen.

8.why: No QR code or any equivalent alternative to manual entry is offered on the only screen shown.

9.why: There are no input fields at all, so browser autofill and password-manager support cannot be present.

10.why: No step indicator or primary action is visible, only a loading status and an empty 'Logs' box, so neither the current step nor a main action stands out.

11.why: The screen requests no action at all, so the claim that one main action is asked for at a time does not hold.

12.why: The only feedback is the vague 'Loading secure setup...' line, which never confirms what happened or states what comes next.

13.why: No retry, reveal/hide, or re-request controls exist anywhere on the screen.

14.why: No error messages are shown at all, so there is nothing that states the problem and how to fix it.

15.why: No countdowns, session timeouts, or auto-updating timers appear on the observed screen, so no reading time limit is imposed, though generous code-entry time cannot be confirmed because no code entry ever appears.
